extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x) = x^n where n is a real number, then f'(x) = nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If c is a constant and f(x) is differentiable, then d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Sum and Difference Rules
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f and g are differentiable, then d/dx[f(x) ± g(x)] = f'(x) ± g'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative of Exponential Function e^x
aliases: 指数函数 e^x 的导数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(e^x) = e^x; the exponential function is its own derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative of a^x
aliases: 指数函数 a^x 的导数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(a^x) = a^x · ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Euler's Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Unique number for which lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operation of computing a derivative; the inverse of antidifferentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse operation of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration as inverse operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: v(t) = s'(t), the derivative of position with respect to time.

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: a(t) = v'(t) = s''(t), the second derivative of position.

extracted_concepts.name: Position Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function s(t) describing position at time t.

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: MC = C'(x), the derivative of cost function in economics.

extracted_concepts.name: Cost Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function C(x) describing total cost at production level x.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative interpreted as an instantaneous rate of change of a quantity.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions of the form involving powers of x; differentiable via Power Rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function of the form a^x, with base a > 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function of the form f(x) = c; derivative is 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-Order Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of a derivative, e.g., s''(t) = (s'(t))'.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Property of a function possessing a derivative at a point.

extracted_relations.evidence: Power Rule differentiates polynomials via their power terms.
